t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Ensure you focus properly. Do not favour certain gnomes based on looks as there is not certainty on which gnomes give higher bonuses. Take advantage of rests to relax your eyes.

vb_textbox.text: The game requires undivided attention. Try not to favour a specific type of gnome based on colour or shape as this no effect on the number of mushrooms you could possibly earn to improve your overall score. Avoid running out of time or miss out by not hitting the space bar on time as this will reduce your overall score. Take advantage of the breaks to rest your eyes and regain your focus. All the best!
